label: RRL
aesthetic: Worn-in American workwear: indigo denim, flannel/denim work shirts, brown leather boots, rugged jackets.
signature_pieces: chore coat, denim trucker, suede/roughout jacket, shearling
henley or plain tee as base layer

hard.why: Boots are the RRL anchor; loafers and sneakers turn the look Polo or ALD.
Needs a work anchor: a denim/flannel work shirt, or a rugged jacket over a base layer.

min_signals.why: boot + at least 2 of work top / RRL bottom / rugged outer

banned.why: Pleated, dress, linen and light trousers belong to Polo, Faloni or Italian houses.
Polo shirts and collared sweaters read as Polo, Faloni or 545.
Dress, resort and fashion shirts are not work shirts.
Streetwear, collegiate and country knits belong to ALD or Sweet Stable.
Tailored, pastel and technical jackets are off-brand.
Fashion-distressed denim, track pants and striped slim jeans are off-brand.

pairing_rules.why: Denim on denim needs clearly different washes (light top + dark bottom or the reverse; a light denim shirt under a light trucker fails too).
A base-layer top only counts as RRL under a chore, trucker, suede, shearling or field jacket.
In cool weather a rugged jacket is part of the uniform.
Secondary jackets (plaid wool, navy/black cord) go over plain or denim tops, never flannel.

weekend.modifier: Flannel or denim shirt + jean + boot; jacket optional when warm.

weekday.modifier: Casual weekday only. Needs a jacket in fall/winter (RRL-P4); prefer brown chino or dark denim.

out.modifier: Night version: dark denim or brown chino, work shirt tucked, suede/shearling jacket. Soft −10 for light denim.

comfy.modifier: Henley/tee + jean + boot; the jacket rule is relaxed.

summer.modifier: Jacket optional; tee/henley without jacket still fails RRL-P2.

card_note: Worn-in workwear: denim or flannel shirt, straight jean, brown boots.
gap_note: Only 1 boot and 1 dark denim (no indigo selvedge jean): expect repeats.

must_differ.polo: Shoe is always a boot, and the top is a work shirt or rugged jacket, never an oxford/polo + loafer.
must_differ.sweetstable: RRL top is work shirt/henley (no fair isle, gingham or cable as lead); SS needs cord or plaid + country knit.

row_exemptions: Shoe-rotation law exempt: Joe owns 1 boot, so every RRL look repeats g_b4zsf3dfrhdv. Rotate tops and bottoms instead (≤2 looks per bottom in an 8-row).
scoring.empty_state: If 0 looks pass, show no RRL row. Show 1 'closest' card that passes RRL-R1 + RRL-R2 and fails only RRL-P4 (missing jacket), labelled 'Closest RRL: add a chore/trucker', or just the gap note. Never fall back to the All row.
